r15-repeating.title: Work that keeps coming back (like certificate renewals)
body: You asked for the proper way to handle a steady kind of ticket like certificate renewals. My answer: it belongs in a **repeating thing**, not a project. A project is work that finishes; renewals never do. The app was planned this way from the start (entries can belong to a repeating thing), but the screens only ever let you pick projects.

So today you have to choose: a project for the time and code, or a repeating thing for the expiry warning, and the two never meet. These three changes make the repeating thing do both. Only the first one is needed to make it work; the other two make it nicer.
bullets: **Repeating things hold work:** pick one wherever you pick a project (entry details, Log work, the Tickets tray). Its time and tickets count toward it.
**Codes:** a repeating thing can have a timesheet code, or take one from its kind ("Certificates"), so new certificates get it without setting it each time.
**Start renewal:** a due-soon certificate gets a button that opens Log work already filed under it, and the certificate keeps a list of past renewals with their tickets and time.
